title: lepechinia conferta
intro: Lepechinia conferta, commonly known as Mexican mint or mountain mint, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to Mexico. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as relieving digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lepechinia conferta include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
